terra: terra, -ae (f.) — land, earth, ground (nom./abl. sg.) · also f. voc. sg. (ō terra hospita)
teucri: Teucer, Teucrī (m.) — Teucer, early king of Troy (gen. sg.) · also Teucrī, -ōrum (m. pl.) Trojans (voc. pl.: Teucrī, secludite) · also m. nom. pl. (Teucrī, Trojans)
texit: tegō, -ere, tēxī, tēctum — to cover, hide, shelter, protect (3rd sg. perf.)
thybri: Thybris, -is (m.) — the Tiber, river and river-god of Latium (voc. sg., Thybrī; also dat. sg.)
tibi: tū, tuī — you (sg.); tibi, to/for you (dat.)
torrens: torrēns, -entis (m.) — rushing stream, mountain torrent (nom. sg.)
totidem: totidem (indecl. adj.) — just as many, the same number
traicit: trāiciō (trāiiciō), -ere, -iēcī, -iectum — to throw across; to pierce through (3rd sg. pres.)
tua: tuus, -a, -um — your, yours (sg. poss.) (f. nom. sg.) · also n. acc. pl. (tua nūmina) · also f. abl. sg. (tua laude)
tum: tum (adv.) — then, at that time; next
una: ūnus, -a, -um — one, a single (f. abl./nom. sg.); ūnā (adv.), together · also ūnā, adv., once (satis ūnā superque, enough once and more)
unum: ūnus, -a, -um — one, a single, the same (n. nom./acc. sg.; m. acc. sg.)
urget: urgeō, -ēre, ursī — to press, push hard, urge on, bear down on (3rd sg. pres.)
ut: ut (conj.) — + subj. so that, in order that; + indic. as, when, how · also + subj., how (indirect exclamation: cernis ut insultent)
vellit: vellō, -ere, vellī (vulsī), vulsum — to pluck, tear, wrench away (3rd sg. pres.)
velut: velut (adv.) — as, just as, as if
vetusta: vetustus, -a, -um — old, ancient, of long standing (f. abl. sg.)
vidit: videō, -ēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see, behold (3rd sg. perf.)
viri: vir, virī (m.) — man, hero, husband (nom. pl.; gen. sg.) · also voc. pl. (festīnāte, virī)
viribus: vīs, vīs (f.) — force, strength; pl. vīrēs, vīrium, strength (abl./dat. pl.)
virtutem: virtūs, virtūtis (f.) — manliness, courage, valour (acc. sg.)
virum: vir, virī (m.) — man, hero (acc. sg.; also gen. pl., old form = virōrum)
vobis: tū, tuī — you; vōs, vōbīs, to/for you, by you (dat./abl. pl.)
volcania: Volcānius, -a, -um — of Vulcan, Vulcanian (f. nom. sg.; also n. nom./acc. pl.)
vos: tū, vōs — you (2nd pers. pl. pron.) (nom./acc. pl.) · also voc. pl. (vōs, aetērnī ignēs)
